articles.title: Elliott Urges Investors to Resist Toyota Industries Take-Private Bid
articles.mainIdea: Elliott Urges Investors to Resist Toyota Industries Take-Private Bid
articles.summary: GuruFocus.com: Elliott Urges Investors to Resist Toyota Industries Take-Private Bid. Elliott Investment Management has intensified its challenge to the proposed take-private of Toyota Industries Corp. (TYIDY), pressing minority shareholders to resist an offer it views as falling short of the company's potential. In a letter published Monday, the US activist argued that Toyota Industries carries an intrinsic net asset value of 26,000 per share, materially above the Toyota group's revised 18,800 bid, which implies a valuation of about 6.1 trillion. Elliott, which disclosed a 5% stake in Toyota Industries in November, reiterated that it will not tender its shares, even after the offer price was raised just before the tender period opened. Related tickers mentioned: TYIDF.
